output.reason: [ev-9fd85560a485] shows that in the v1beta1 schema of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io, the required list for spec.provider.fake.data items changed from ["key"] to ["key","value"]. So the only exposed objects are v1beta1 ClusterSecretStores that have fake data entries without a value. The proposed condition says exactly that: a ClusterSecretStore resource where spec.provider.fake.data is set and spec.provider.fake.data[].value is unset. Requiring data to be set keeps the condition from flagging stores that have no fake data entries. It also matches the applicability of the existing known fact vf-30c8400eac07.
